level_initialization: fresh identical B seed17 at every independent level; not warm-started
loss: original full-vocabulary answer-token mean CE only
gate: fixed final checkpoint: all train answers correct, mean CE<=0.1, every correct answer probability>=0.9
selection: run sequentially; stop on first failed level, no extension or checkpoint selection
level_1: one original training story and query
level_2: same story both independent entity queries
level_3: both queries of story plus exact reversed-values counterfactual at same fact order
level_4: original balanced 48-response train, original two declared dev panels
generalization: dev descriptive only; gates here certify microfit not linguistic generalization
extra_contrast: only if level3 passes and level4 fails; justify/freeze separately before execution
corrective_optimization: at most one, only with measured concrete cause; otherwise retain negative
restrictions: no Hielo/Trapos/architecture/tokenizer/corpus changes, sealed data, GPU, paid services or pretraining
